_comment: Tracked sample for src/api/YTSkedy.AzureFunctions/local.settings.json. Copy this file to local.settings.json (gitignored) and replace <placeholders> with environment-specific values. Provider credentials for YouTube and WordPress are entered through platform create/update and stored in the Platforms table, not in Functions app settings. Do not commit real OAuth client secrets, refresh tokens, Application Passwords, access tokens, or production storage connection strings.
